footprint_provenance.note: the count and the site type are evidenced; the band is a governed sector default from reference.density_mix, not a finding about this client. It decides which bearers are tested, so it is worth replacing with what the client actually has.

estimate_inputs.note: users and ops_cost_per_site are assumptions, not research. They are stated here because an estimate that hides its inputs cannot be checked.
